comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Progress update: pushed commit f66dc143 to develop.

Root causes fixed:
- Logging test side effect in tests/cli/test_app_helpers.py left tactus logger in propagate=false state and suppressed caplog across later tests.
- MCP adapter wrapper tests were stale after switch to **kwargs tool signatures and agent-level success recording.
- LLM backend tests expected removed JSON parsing/retry behavior.
- Agent/model primitive edge cases needed guardrails (missing last_call, missing context.log_handler).
- classify.spec LLM mocks did not match new suffixed model names (stdlib_classify_llm_N).

Validation run locally:
- black --check tactus/ tests/ features/steps/ ✅
- rcql --mode standard-findings -v --limit 50 ✅ (0 findings)
- previously failing test cluster ✅ (467 passed)
- classify.spec BDD ✅

Awaiting GitHub Actions Release run on develop for final close.

Local verification:

- black --check for updated files ✅

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Second follow-up fix pushed: adfce4f6 on develop.

The previous run still showed logging-capture flakes in many modules. To eliminate cross-file leakage comprehensively, I added an autouse fixture in tests/conftest.py that snapshots and restores tactus/root logger handlers, levels, and propagate flags around every test.

This makes caplog assertions deterministic regardless of test ordering.

Local validation:
- targeted cluster of all previously failing caplog tests passed
- black --check on touched files passed

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Third follow-up fix pushed: a02b709f on develop.

PR run 24373445594 failed only on Python 3.10 for tests/dspy/test_agent_execution.py::TestTurns::test_turn_with_streaming_exception_group. Root cause: agent error unwrapping only recognized class name ExceptionGroup; Python 3.10 path emits BaseExceptionGroup.

Action taken: broadened unwrap condition to class names ending with ExceptionGroup so both ExceptionGroup and BaseExceptionGroup are normalized consistently.

Validation:
- targeted exception-group test passed locally
- black formatting re-run on touched file
